parameters.formDescription: Submit a new content brief to the HITL pipeline (Sofia → Marcus → Taylor)

values.placeholder: e.g. Product announcement, Thought leadership, Culture post
e.g. Founder voice, direct, not corporate

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-4-6', max_tokens: 1500, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.sofia_prompt }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({
  formType: '{{SOFIA_TEMPLATE_ID}}',
  callbackUrl: $execution.resumeUrl,
  data: {
    client: $json.client_name,
    platform: $json.platform,
    content_type: $json.content_type,
    ai_angles: $json.content[0].text,
    _ctx: JSON.stringify({
      client_name: $json.client_name,
      platform: $json.platform,
      content_type: $json.content_type,
      topic_hint: $json.topic_hint,
      tone_note: $json.tone_note,
      brand_guide: $json.brand_guide,
      platform_playbook: $json.platform_playbook,
      workflow_start_time: $json.workflow_start_time,
      iterations_sofia: $json.iterations_sofia,
      iterations_marcus: $json.iterations_marcus,
      approved_angle: $json.approved_angle,
      marcus_feedback: $json.marcus_feedback
    })
  }
}) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-4-6', max_tokens: 2000, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.marcus_prompt }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({
  formType: '{{MARCUS_TEMPLATE_ID}}',
  callbackUrl: $execution.resumeUrl,
  data: {
    angle: $json.approved_angle,
    post_copy: $json.post_copy,
    image_direction: $json.image_direction,
    taylor_preview: $json.taylor_preview_md,
    _ctx: JSON.stringify({
      client_name: $json.client_name,
      platform: $json.platform,
      content_type: $json.content_type,
      topic_hint: $json.topic_hint,
      tone_note: $json.tone_note,
      brand_guide: $json.brand_guide,
      platform_playbook: $json.platform_playbook,
      workflow_start_time: $json.workflow_start_time,
      iterations_sofia: $json.iterations_sofia,
      iterations_marcus: $json.iterations_marcus,
      approved_angle: $json.approved_angle,
      post_copy: $json.post_copy,
      image_direction: $json.image_direction
    })
  }
}) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-4-6', max_tokens: 1000, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.taylor_prompt }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({
  formType: '{{TAYLOR_TEMPLATE_ID}}',
  callbackUrl: $execution.resumeUrl,
  data: {
    post_copy: $json.post_copy,
    image_direction: $json.image_direction,
    original_brief: $json.topic_hint,
    ai_summary: $json.ai_summary,
    ai_flags: $json.ai_flags,
    ai_recommendation: $json.ai_recommendation,
    _ctx: JSON.stringify({
      client_name: $json.client_name,
      platform: $json.platform,
      content_type: $json.content_type,
      topic_hint: $json.topic_hint,
      tone_note: $json.tone_note,
      brand_guide: $json.brand_guide,
      platform_playbook: $json.platform_playbook,

      iterations_sofia: $json.iterations_sofia,
      iterations_marcus: $json.iterations_marcus,
      approved_angle: $json.approved_angle,
      post_copy: $json.post_copy,
      image_direction: $json.image_direction,
      taylor_approval_round: ($json.taylor_approval_round || 0) + 1
    })
  }
}) }}
